author: Justincreblie
quote: Such a horrible game.Eight hours in and it has given nothing to be proud of, the characters are horrendous compared to GTA 5 and are the most boring video game characters possibly to ever be created. Can not believe we waited 13 years for a relationship sims with better graphics. Copious amounts of bugs the game is near unplayable, for not having a physical copy and the amount of delays on release there is no excuse for such a pathetic game. Also had a lackluster campaign that’s more soft-core porn than actual substance. So much squandered potential the biggest disappointment ever that Rockstar has produced. Waste of 13 years waiting for something so horrible. Save your money and play GTA5 if you like rockstar games. This one was not it, and deserves to be buried Forever. Wish I could sell this game immediately but unfortunately they didn’t make a physical copy because they knew people would hate it and want to return it faster than they pre-ordered it.

author: Justincreblie
quote: Such an amazing remake of an already amazing and innovative video game! After the reviews and clips of the game i had to go out and get a switch 2 to try it myself and without a doubt it did not fail to impress me! Will be playing again & again!
